name: Jarvis Self Check
description: Check Jarvis host and watch-ledger health, update one durable Canvas page, and raise separate deduped alerts for host issues or stale, failed, and parked watch work.

variables.issue_summary: System health check has not run yet.

steps.description: Collect compact local system health signals
Read watch health without modifying snapshots or deliveries; no watches is healthy and ordinary pending work is informational
Find the durable Jarvis System Health Canvas page

params.title: ${canvas_title}

steps.description: Create the durable health page on first run
Create a deduped alert after the health Canvas page is refreshed

params.title: Jarvis watch health needs attention
params.description: Watch health check ${watch_check_status}: ${watch_stale_count} stale watches, ${watch_error_count} errors, ${watch_parked_count} parked deliveries. ${watch_pending_count} deliveries remain pending; failed attempts are included in the error count. Review Workflows/Jarvis System Health in Canvas.

steps.description: Raise a non-speaking watch-health alert only after its Canvas report is saved

success_speech: Jarvis self-check complete. Host status ${health_status} with ${issue_count} issue(s). Watch check ${watch_check_status}: ${watch_stale_count} stale, ${watch_error_count} errors, ${watch_parked_count} parked deliveries.
partial_speech: Jarvis self-check partially complete. Host status ${health_status} with ${issue_count} issue(s). Watch check ${watch_check_status}: ${watch_stale_count} stale, ${watch_error_count} errors, ${watch_parked_count} parked deliveries.
abort_speech: I couldn't complete the Jarvis self-check workflow.
